description: This file defines the Bestseller model class for an OpenCart module, handling database operations related to bestselling products such as install/uninstall, editing totals, retrieval of reports, and deletion.

classes.name: Bestseller
classes.description: Model class managing bestseller product data, including table creation, updates, and retrieval of report data.

methods.name: install
methods.description: Creates the 'product_bestseller' table in the database if it does not exist.

methods.name: uninstall
methods.description: Drops the 'product_bestseller' table from the database if it exists.

methods.name: editTotal
methods.description: Updates or inserts the total sales count for a specific product identified by product_id.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the bestseller record for a given product_id.

methods.name: getReports
methods.description: Retrieves a list of bestseller records ordered by total sales, supports pagination via start and limit parameters.

methods.name: getTotalReports
methods.description: Returns the total count of bestseller records in the database.
